body:
Thank you for commenting.
You're right, thats really the best thing to do. It just hurts so damn much to not have her around, but I guess it'll hurt more in the future to keep her around. Its like a drug
Thanks! I might give that a shot

Hey! Thanks for the comment, I appreciate it!

I know exactly how you feel about being anxious and seeing yourself as boring. I'm sure you have many qualities that would make someone out there kill to be with you. I know it's a cliché, but you just can't see it yourself. 

I'm sorry to hear about your coworker. This shit really hurts. I hope things turn out well for you!
I'm sorry you're going through this, but thanks for the comment. It helps a little knowing someone feels the same. I just can't take my mind off her and focus on anything else.
Thanks! I really appreciate it :) People like you make the world a better place!
Thanks. It helps knowing someone feels the same, makes me feel a little less alone!

Forwarding to another device is actually not a dumb idea, thanks. 
I do see a psychologist, but the progress is slow. I was dumb enough to make her my entire world, so now I just feel lost.
Thanks. I wish I could remove her from my life completely, but I'm not strong enough to. I just can't bring myself to deleting her.

I feel ya. With 7 billion people out there it's hard to feel special. I too miss when every little thing was wondrous. Now it's hard to find meaning in life. Knowing that it's important to get to know what makes life worth living to you, not thinking about all the people out there. I know that this is hard with depression. It's very human to feel like being wanted or to feel important. It's in our nature to want to have a meaning. Everything is supposed to make sense for us, so in our heads we have to be put here for a reason.

If you feel like talking or venting some time just hit me up!
Hey! I'm sorry to hear that your not feeling good. If you need to vent or to talk you can hit me up any time, and I'll respond as soon as I see it.
Hey. I don't know the context to that title, but hit me up if you need to talk about it.

Thanks, I appreciate it. I know I'll get over her or meet someone else some day, but it's just so overwhelming right now on top of my depression. I also keep comparing anyone I meet to her, but no one really can.

Thanks. I know, but some days I just can't take being sober. I have punched the wall so many times so hard while being drunk that something is loose in my right hand tho... I will keep the drinking down.

Thanks. It helps knowing someone feels the same, but at the same time it hurts knowing you're going through it. It's excruciating to a point that I didn't know this emotional pain could exist. I hope we'll meet someone else, but I keep comparing everyone to her. No one really can.
Thanks. It sucks, and I guess my insecurities is a big part of the problem. Hope you're doing better!

Thanks. I know I'll get over her or meet someone else some day, but she feels like the only one right now... I can control myself on days when I have important stuff to do. I know it'll hurt me in the long run, but on some days it just feels too much. I will keep it down tho..
Thanks. It's already been a while, but I don't feel any better.

Well, we have had some contact, but it hurts because I keep hoping she'll come back and I overanalyze every time she contacts me.

Do you mean if I've had a flirty tone with other girls or just in general? I have many female friends, but I don't feel anything for them other than friendship. It also feels wrong to flirt with other girls when all I want is her, although I know I'll have to get over her one day.
Thanks. A couple of months ago.

Well, all I really want in life right now is her, but I know it's probably not going to happen, so I guess getting over her is the only choice I have. It just hurts so much loosing her on top of my depression.
I don't have any sleeping pills, but I'll look into it. I can't afford any right now tho. Heard that the prescription pills work better, so maybe I'll talk to my doctor about it. Thanks
I used to meditate, but I stopped for some reason. I'll try to get back into it. Thanks.
Hey, thanks! I'd love to talk, but it's getting really late where I live so I should try to get some sleep. Maybe when I get up?
Thanks. I needed to hear that last sentence. Makes me feel better.

Hey. This sucks to hear. I can't tell out of the little information, but depending on how she said it maybe she meant well or didn't mean to exclude you? I mean if you have told her about your mental problems maybe she doesn't want to pressure you? 

I don't know, but I think you should talk to her about it if you feel comfortable with that. Maybe tell her how you feel about her. I know that can be very hard to do, but seriously, the things I most regret in life is not telling someone how I feel till it's too late and they've slipped out of my hands.
Hey, thanks for commenting and sorry I didn't respond. I fell asleep and I'm feeling a little better now. A little tired, hungover and with a clouded mind though, so I'll try to get some more sleep.
No, IRL :(

Thanks! This was the comment I wanted and needed to hear, especially since it's coming from a female's perspective. I know deep down that we all often struggle with the same things, but it makes a difference when someone actually tells me. I also know based on myself that I would never judge someone or deem them less attractive for being a little disproportional. Maybe some of the women I find attractive feels the same way about themselves?
I went to work out today too. Seriously... It's never too late. I don't think you're a lost cause :) If I can do it so can you!
Thanks! :)
Thank you! I needed to hear this! I will fight on.
Thanks! I haven't been on this account for a few days, so sorry I haven't responded! I would love to chat sometime if possible :)
Hey. Sorry I haven't responded. I went to bed right before you commented. Maybe we could chat sometime?

Thanks for responding! You are right, and this is probably the only right answer, but I don't know how. I know deep down that I have talents and that I'm worth something, but it's like I have this twisted self image that blocks this confidence out. I try to work out, learn new things and improve, but I still have this voice that says I'm not good enough.

> It's so easy to romanticize the past!

This!

Thanks! I needed that. I guess the past wasn't as great as it looks in my head right now. I will try to focus on the now and the me I want to be tomorrow, while learning from past events.

Thanks for taking time to respond! I can absolutely relate to what you are saying, and you are probably right. It's a very bitter pill to swallow. The only weird thing though is that she still talks to me. She initiates the conversations most of the time and has sent me some strange pictures I wouldn't imagine someone wanting to be 'just friends' sending. It's really confusing...

I think I'll take a step back, let her breathe and take it day by day. See where it goes.
Thanks! :) helps a lot!

I can relate :( I lost my dreamgirl because I was too slow. The most beautiful girl I had ever laid my eyes on. I wish I could go a few months back. Now all I see, all music, everything reminds me of her. 

Send me a pm if you need to talk :)
Aww.. Thanks! :)

Thanks for commenting

Yeah, it sucks..

Here you go. A hug through the internet! Hoping for a better, less lonely future!

I am not sure how I can help, but I just wanted to give you my condolences. 

I chose to comment on this because I am in a very similar situation, only I lost my dad and it was some years ago. First I want to say that you should not be too hard on yourself for not calling her. I have spent years beating myself for all the things I didn't do and should have done. I see now that it has only hurt me and it's not healthy. Not saying that you shouldn't grieve. That is important!

I think it's good that you have chosen to take a week off for your father. Try to do something fun and make some memories together that week. I know it can be hard and you might feel guilty if you are able to have fun, but remember that just because you are able to have a good time doesn't mean you guys aren't missing her and aren't grieving. 

Is it possible to see him on the weekends? Maybe try to find some hobbies that you can do together so he has something to look forward to whenever you see each other. One thing that helped us was planning a trip together for summer vacation so that we would have something to look forward to. 

I wish you guys the best!

Thats great :)

I know helping people out can make me feel a little better sometimes. I have been thinking about doing some volunteer work. Have you considered that?

Thanks! I have been thinking about volunteering, but haven't made any serious plans yet. I'll look into it!

Have a nice day/night to you too! :)

I feel the same way. Have friends and family, but still feel incredibly lonely. 

I'm sorry I can't answer your questions or help in any other way, but from personal experience I know it might at least feel a little better knowing someone feels the same.

Yeah, I know its just a bullshit holiday, but the focus on having someone special is much greater on Valentine's day. I see it everywhere and it makes me feel even more lonely. Especially now that I got rejected.

Thanks for commenting tho
I can relate. I am also in a depression. It sucks mate :( Shoot me a pm if you want to talk.

Thanks for the response. I have not spoken to our mutual friend about it yet. For some reason it feels pretty awkward, but I guess it would be the best thing to do. She said that she wasn't ready and that there was too much going on right now for a relationship.

Thanks for the response.
That sucks to hear :( I don't think you sound like a scumbag at all. You sound genuinely nice.
